review_text: Thoroughly workmanlike return flights Johannesburg to Cape Town Cabin crew were efficient and personable Seats AC had adequate leg room Food was adequate and it was helpful to see the three main courses before choosing one Both flights arrived ahead of schedule

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

Nice airport Fairly modern The washrooms were clean and well maintained Its a fairly small airport There seemed to be a lot of security around the day we departed Airside international there is not much choice of food however I noticed across the road seemed to be popular with locals There was a coffee shop ouch for an iced coffee also some food there very expensive Going through security etc you go upstairs via escalator The oddest sight all booths open for both security and immigration yet we were the only ones there First time thats ever happened and I suspect last There were a few places to eat or drink airside and they seemed ok although we were not hungry Definitely liked this airport A very positive experience

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free
Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

Super small airport and wonderful if you are meeting someone from Hamilton Car rentals from site were out of cars and were no help Cost bucks to take cab from airport to in town car rental agency Tim Hortons only outlet in airport on arrival side or vending machines Flying with Flair and can only get tickets printed and drop off suitcases two hours before flight What we thought we were saving to get to a Blue Jays game in Toronto cost us more by flying to this back wood airport than what it would have been to fly WestJet to Toronto Never again will stick with West Jet friendly and helpful and reliable And the Blue Jays lost which made the trip even more horrible

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

If youre coming from a western country be aware that this airport functions a bit differently than what were used to First you and all your bags have to pass through security bags in the scanner you in a light body search and then you enter the hall where the airlines check in counters are You do not need to present a boarding pass to enter this first hall meaning you can come in with a friend or family member who isnt flying This hall has some chairs toilets and or shops After you check in and drop your bags with your airline you proceed to immigration At this point you can only get through if you have a valid boarding pass You get to a second hall with the duty free and a couple more shops and restaurants Last you move to the area where your gate is Theres different areas with different gates each with their own security line if you go to the wrong gate area like I did you need to ask airport staff to escort you out so you can go to the correct area This security check is the same as the first one bags on the scanners and you get a light body search Then you proceed to your gates waiting area where you have toilets and shops No one ever checks for liquids or electronic equipments and I even had my own bottle of water in my bag when I went through both security checks Men and women have different security lines so that man are searched by a male officer and women searched by a female one As for facilities there were enough chairs for everyone but chairs were not the most comfortable If you like shopping in airport this is also not the best place not enough offer of shops and even the duty free doesnt have much to offer The airport is generally clean and there are western toilets plus free water On arrivals immigration lines are often under staffed so prepare for waiting mins If youre looking to exchange money at the airport you need go back the stairs after you collect your luggage because the money exchange counter is on the departures floor

ARNHEL on the standard B Clean and airy cabin legroom fine for such a short hop Coffeetea served for free Courteous FAs gave out a stuffed toy for the baby in our party and took extra care explaining how the infants seatbelt worked Bags were on the belt in minutes at HEL

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport
The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Employees are helpful and polite Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

I have to say I found the staff exceptionally helpful My dad requires special assistance and the staff were prompt understanding and efficient and could not do enough for him The airport is clean and obviously busy

Landing in Carrasco is a nice experience if the plane approaches the tarmac overflying the nice beaches and architecture Immigration did not take more than a few minutes and luggage was efficiently delivered it is necessary to go through a dutyfree in order to reach the hall where the conveyors are placed After customs the main lobby is very illuminated with natural light and spotlessly clean Taxis are abundant and comfortable and the airport is located about minutes from downtown However some of the carhiring companies are not located in the terminal but there is an efficient shuttle service to their offices

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Birmingham to Zurich I am an incredibly nervous flyer and was flying at weeks pregnant so much more anxious than usual When I checked in the airline immediately clocked that I was pregnant and told me to come and queue up with priority customers even though I was flying economy When I did they showed me to a seat to sit in while I waited for the coach which was so helpful and kind On the plane the hostess noticed my anxiety during takeoff and throughout the flight they checked in with me constantly with such patience and kindness offering me a bottle of water to sip and calm my breathing down giving comforting reassurances at the slightest sign of turbulence and before we landed coming and offering a little cuddly toy plane for my unborn baby The genuinely caring nature of all the staff was absolutely superb and such an enormous comfort to a more vulnerable person I was so grateful and thoroughly impressed with every staff member involved at each step of the way

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Unhelpful Disorganized Was on a layover from Amsterdam to Toronto Canada I arrived through KLM airlines but my luggage didnt When I asked about my luggage the luggage staff said they transferred it to my next flight which they dont do and my itinerary said baggage not checked through When I left luggage collection and went to the check in area I asked a staff member if they could confirm it was sent through and they said with certainty that they would not have transferred my luggage and to go check again I went back to check again but security would not let me back into the luggage area I told them the story and without even looking at my flight itinerary said it was transferred to my next flight I had no contact with this security officer before nor did they know anything about my situation prior Now to be clear its almost certain that KLM lost my luggage and its not the luggage handlers problem But for them to just lie about it to get rid of me is unacceptable They could have said it appears it didnt arrive and thats fine I cant blame them for that But I just essentially went back and forth between people in the airport not knowing who was telling the truth or who knows what theyre talking about I dont expect Mexico City airport to be the best airport in the world but to be an international airport that essentially has no centralized information center and to have employees who just lie to get rid of you is really unacceptable Im sure they dont get paid the most and I get that

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

Nice modern clean airport with plenty of checkin rows Food options fine with a McD and noodle shops WiFi not always present The only nuissance in this airport on departure is the number of times you have to show your boarding pass and passport times yes

I had to visit Abidjan this January There is no doubt the airport is more than a pleasant surprise One would expect the worst for any West African ariport in general and even more for this one keeping in mind that the country is fairly isolated and suffering from heavy civil unrest and at the edge of civil war keeping most western travellers and business away In fact the airport corresponds totally to European counterparts of the same size fairly small thus The terminal building is very new and has been totally rebuild in a quite recent past with all confort one can expect Aircondition normal sanitary facilities and yes all is clean and in good working condition On arrival jet aircrafts just dock at a direct tunnel connection to the building distances are quite short All controls are very smooth with absolutely no bribes to give to any official While standing in line for passport control a doctor passes trough the lines and checks vaccinations Yellow fever is compulsory every where there is security passport control is smooth and efficient although every one tries to be closest to the luggage belt this also goes quite smoothly including inspection of luggage No unauthorized people in the arrival area and nowhere unpleasant people insisting on helping you carrying your luggage and then trying to run away with it apparently some people do have a sort of authorization to enter customs area for helping passengers but not insisting Departure also is quite smooth Check in is done in an enclosed area with identity check at the entrance so here also one is safe after checking in there is just a short way up the stairs passing customs and then to the departure hall Here also with all normal facilities duty free shop large restaurant area some smaller shops and sanitary facilities still clean and in good working order Altogether thus a pleasant experience

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta

The south domestic terminal in Anchorage is world class and beautiful This new terminal is very modern spotlessly clean provides amenities expected at an international airport and offers a view of the surrounding mountains that is breathless The displays of local wildlife native culture and art is unsurpassed by most airports in the world However the old north terminal which is now connected to the south terminal by a concourse is sad Anchorage is one of the five most busy airports in the world for international cargo airlines but not for international passenger service The few international airlines that do provide passenger service mostly during the summer months are forced to use the north terminal as US customs is located there All the comments seen on this site are about the north terminal made by international travelers and are undoubtedly true Wish they all could have been processed through the magnificent south building
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

Although capacity has been enhanced and facilities are relatively better overall cleanliness and passenger comfort eg Efficiency of air conditioning is still far from satisfactory I live in Pune and would want this airport to be one of the best in the true sense Customer experience must be top class at such an important airport There is a lot of room for improvement

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

JNZDLC Flight departed and arrived on schedule Aircraft was newish MA clean and tidy Cabin announcements in English as well as Chinese but no cabin service only hour flight so acceptable especially given price of ticket RMB Aircraft named Modern Ark apt as modernised Chinese version of old Antinov design Overall perfectly acceptable

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

I usually travel to Tenerife South and North airports several times a month The most important thing for me is the fastest way thru security and food services On both airports usually time waited for security screening is less than min average time min staff polite and very helpful The food and services offered in Tenerife South is much better than the older airport in the north of the island I have used both airports VIP lounge They are nice have lots of food and drink and usually are ok Sometimes during peak season can be a bit crowded or even full

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

Birmingham to Zurich I am an incredibly nervous flyer and was flying at weeks pregnant so much more anxious than usual When I checked in the airline immediately clocked that I was pregnant and told me to come and queue up with priority customers even though I was flying economy When I did they showed me to a seat to sit in while I waited for the coach which was so helpful and kind On the plane the hostess noticed my anxiety during takeoff and throughout the flight they checked in with me constantly with such patience and kindness offering me a bottle of water to sip and calm my breathing down giving comforting reassurances at the slightest sign of turbulence and before we landed coming and offering a little cuddly toy plane for my unborn baby The genuinely caring nature of all the staff was absolutely superb and such an enormous comfort to a more vulnerable person I was so grateful and thoroughly impressed with every staff member involved at each step of the way

CHA is a compact but efficient airport serving a metropolitan market of about residents In the past it has suffered from proximity to major airports in Nashville and Atlanta but today airlines service Chattanooga with a rather rapidly growing number of destinations The airport is very clean with free WiFi throughout and parking and security is superior Low fare airlines have joined the legacy carriers so there is quite a nice selection of flights and fares Sure saves time and headaches of leaving from larger airports

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

The new Terminal C is a significant improvement over the old Delta terminal This is a spacious terminal with plenty of light from the floor to ceiling windows giving views of the airport runwaysaprons and CitiField and Arthur Ashe Stadium The walk from gate to gate was rather long Restrooms are plentiful and clean however in some locations they could use more stalls given the number of passengers who traverse this terminal Dining options are placed conveniently I had a delicious lunch at one of the restaurants The airport WiFi is very fast and worked flawlessly

The new terminal is very spacious and it was apparent they were putting in additional shops and services but was under construction when we departed Very clean and modern One thing I miss about the old terminal is that it was right on the end of the electric tram line So you could walk out of the airport to a tram and pay about dollars for a ride into the city You can still get to the tram but its an awkward walk You have to walk about minutes to reach it Also the kantorcurrency exchange was outside of security so after we had gone through passport control I couldnt exchange money So hopefully theyll fix that There was free internet near a cafe but couldnt easily find power So most people had to run off of battery There was a nice hotel we had used in the past affordable and clean but it was closed for renovation Hope they dont raise the prices upon reopening They really jazzed up the airport and city for the world cup

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

Please can someone improve the signage when you leave Nice airport to go to the motorway to Monaco We always end up going round and round roundabouts looking for the sign to MonacoGenoa and end up going through parts of Nice and joining the motorway at a later junction If we take the train to Monaco from St Augustin Station the signage from the airport to the station is inadequate Please can the airport management arrange to improve the signage to and from the airport to the station and Monaco One wonders does anyone care about the customers at Nice Airport For example the BA checkin desk is substandard with unfriendly staff The whole experience at Nice airport is not a pleasant one If senior staff at Nice airport read this review one wonders if they are bothered to do anything about it We live in hope

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

This was my nd flight to FLL in months after a year absence This review is limited to Terminal Arrival was at the A Concourse gates which mean a rather long connectors to the BC concourses common area One huge advantage of FLL airport over the others is the car rental facility which is directly across the airport roadway from the terminal The renovated terminal is spacious brightly lit and has a central TSA Entry point for all concourses Each concourse offers dining options a plenty For Christmas Day travel there was enough seating for all with power ports and USB ports at each gate The bathrooms are very clean and maintained at regular intervals Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished Terminal is a joy to travel through

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Brussels to Lanzarote Nice little airline Both outbound and return flights on time Food premium menu delicious Swift and attentive service of the staff Clean aircraft on both ways We booked emergency exit seats which offered extra legroom which is a bonus on h flights Would recommend this airline for sure such a shame that this brand will probably disappear
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

When we arrived at Luxor airport got off the coach all I can say was what appeared like a pack of wolves were waiting to help with bags Now Im a ft stone bloke so am well capable but even despite this I ended up almost having to wrestle my bag away from a very eager helper who all the time was whispering under his breath drink please interspersed with something It appeared as if there was a supervisor or someone that they didnt want to hear their requests if so they were spectacularly unsuccessful in stamping out this sort of overaggressive help Having managed to wrestle free of the initial wave of helpers get inside the building once again there was another helper to lift bags onto the xray belt This time however as he didnt have any English phrases apparently the helper was saying something in Egyptian again whispering while showing me an Egyptian Pound note folded in the palm of his hand as a prompt Having now managed to get through these levels of assistance there was of course another helper at the other end of the xray machine who was equally helpful in taking the bag off the belt similarly looking for money Next up was the checkin desk itself yes you have guessed it there was yet another helper at the head of the queue to again lift the bag onto the checkin conveyor There is a sign on display at the desk stating that all baggage assistance was free of charge but this was clearly not having any effect on the various helpers that have to be negotiatedovercome Finally naturally there is the customary help in the toilets where even though I am at yrs of age well capable of washing drying my hands I was presented with some toilet paper with the by now customary demand for money All in all never again

As we know PV has become for so many of us a wonderful holiday escape destination andor many of us are living here now Great millions coming through the PVR airport new records of last year but they truly have to improve their arrival at PVR as its quite pitiful now after you try to get out after going through immigration and claiming your luggages We accept the fact that they have a right to really check all luggage now via security scan but PLZ use ALL of your scanning machines as when I came in only two were used and the rest were sitting idle when the lines for waiting were just impossible Its not they do not have the facilities or staff as many of them were just standing there and talking between each other For me its a real lack of organization and I dont know anyone who is really happy facing arrival at PVR as most of us its really mostly the opposite Why cant they get better organized as the flow of tourists arriving daily is on the increase they know about it but this funnel style of checking us to get out truly needs much more attention as it should be much smoother and less frustrating Its getting to be now one of the worse airport to arrive totally frustrating when you see they have the techno to check our luggage via Xray machines but they only use the minimal of them I just dont get it as PVR is NOT fun at ALL when you get there

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

I recently had the opportunity to fly with Batik Air Malaysia and my experience was a mix of satisfaction and simplicity Batik Air is known for providing basic services without the frills and it certainly lived up to that reputation The seating arrangements on the plane were comfortable but dont expect any luxurious features The seats were standard with enough legroom for a short to mediumhaul flight However the absence of inflight entertainment and limited amenities made the journey quite straightforward For those who prioritize a nofuss travel experience this may be a positive aspect One notable issue was the apparent lack of thoroughness in the cabin crews safety checks during the landing phase It was concerning to observe that the crew did not seem as attentive as one would expect in ensuring that all passengers were securely seated and that all items were stowed away properly The usual announcements and visual checks were noticeably absent creating a sense of unease among passengers Safety is paramount in air travel and any oversight during critical phases of the flight such as landing is a cause for concern It is imperative that the cabin crew conducts meticulous checks to guarantee the wellbeing of passengers This lack of attention to detail on Batik Air raises questions about the airlines commitment to ensuring a safe travel experience
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

A very large airport with not many flights There were heaps of gates not being used The airport itself though was very nice clean with lots of places for food and beverages although service at a couple of those places left a bit to be desired There was also a little play area near our gate for our son We hired a trolley from outside but there was nowhere to drop it off inside you had to go out and then go back in via security so we just abandoned ours in the hall Several other people had done the same and we saw someone gather them a small thing that can be easily fixed Security very fast and nice man on duty

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

I upgraded from Economy to Economy Sleeper on this hour flight This gives you a row of three standard economy seats to yourself in a separate and quieter segment of the cabin between economy and business You also get a mattress pillow and duvet the idea being that you can sleep across the three seats This does not really work because If you try to lie flat your feet stick out into the aisle If you prop yourself up sitting with your back to the window the inner arm rest sticks into your back The mattress which is meant to be attached via straps to the seats slides off easily when you move If there is turbulence and you have to fasten your seat belt it is not possible to do this while lying horizontally across the seats Standard economy seats lack the depth needed lie down comfortably across them You cannot watch a programme on the entertainment system in a horizontal position I tried for a while to find a comfortable position but gave up in the end and just sat in my reclined seat Its a nice idea and was worth a try but it does not deliver It was quite a costly upgrade too and the airline would be better served converting that midsection into proper premium economy with more comfortable and spacious seats Of the rows on each side of the cabin only two were occupied which perhaps reflects the point I am making about value for money The service throughout was excellent and my review and ratings refer specifically to the Economy Sleeper offer

This is a small airport Check in and security are painless Airside there are now gates There is floor to ceiling glass affording nice views of the Tetons There is plenty of comfortable seating in the gate area that would get high marks from the people at Sleeping In Airports You still have to walk on the tarmac to board your plane Sadly the food choices are unchanged from my last trip through That is my only complaint Still this is a very nice tertiary level airport As always be sure to book an F side window seat for your daytime flight in

I recently had the opportunity to fly with Batik Air Malaysia and my experience was a mix of satisfaction and simplicity Batik Air is known for providing basic services without the frills and it certainly lived up to that reputation The seating arrangements on the plane were comfortable but dont expect any luxurious features The seats were standard with enough legroom for a short to mediumhaul flight However the absence of inflight entertainment and limited amenities made the journey quite straightforward For those who prioritize a nofuss travel experience this may be a positive aspect One notable issue was the apparent lack of thoroughness in the cabin crews safety checks during the landing phase It was concerning to observe that the crew did not seem as attentive as one would expect in ensuring that all passengers were securely seated and that all items were stowed away properly The usual announcements and visual checks were noticeably absent creating a sense of unease among passengers Safety is paramount in air travel and any oversight during critical phases of the flight such as landing is a cause for concern It is imperative that the cabin crew conducts meticulous checks to guarantee the wellbeing of passengers This lack of attention to detail on Batik Air raises questions about the airlines commitment to ensuring a safe travel experience

This is a very small airport but it is clean convenient and easy to get around Passing through security was a breeze no big queues to wait at The waiting room was easy to find and it was nice clean and comfortable There isnt many places to eat or shop but I really dont care for that Airport staff was ok they arent the friendliest out there but they werent rude either It is a shame there is no public transport access to the airport except for a mini bus that links to the major hotels but not to the city

If youre coming from a western country be aware that this airport functions a bit differently than what were used to First you and all your bags have to pass through security bags in the scanner you in a light body search and then you enter the hall where the airlines check in counters are You do not need to present a boarding pass to enter this first hall meaning you can come in with a friend or family member who isnt flying This hall has some chairs toilets and or shops After you check in and drop your bags with your airline you proceed to immigration At this point you can only get through if you have a valid boarding pass You get to a second hall with the duty free and a couple more shops and restaurants Last you move to the area where your gate is Theres different areas with different gates each with their own security line if you go to the wrong gate area like I did you need to ask airport staff to escort you out so you can go to the correct area This security check is the same as the first one bags on the scanners and you get a light body search Then you proceed to your gates waiting area where you have toilets and shops No one ever checks for liquids or electronic equipments and I even had my own bottle of water in my bag when I went through both security checks Men and women have different security lines so that man are searched by a male officer and women searched by a female one As for facilities there were enough chairs for everyone but chairs were not the most comfortable If you like shopping in airport this is also not the best place not enough offer of shops and even the duty free doesnt have much to offer The airport is generally clean and there are western toilets plus free water On arrivals immigration lines are often under staffed so prepare for waiting mins If youre looking to exchange money at the airport you need go back the stairs after you collect your luggage because the money exchange counter is on the departures floor

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

Chongqing Airport is one of the biggest in Southwest China The new terminal is just km away from the old terminal and is well connected by metro line The airport terminal is very spacious and well designed that incorporates with many new technologies Mine was a direct flight by Hainan Airline to JFK The departure area has all sort of restaurants and shops which makes the last minute shopping possible Facilities are very clean and well put My only concern is the long waiting time at the border control

I am only writing this review because so many things are off about this airport I definitely expected more as its a huge airport with tons of revenue from the gaming here The companion care restroom was locked as someone who needs this restroom and cannot use the other ones I was waiting for about minutes I knocked several times After minutes I called the courtesy phone operator concerned that someone was in there and unwell or unconscious No one responded then another person called on his own volition and still no one came This is a HUGE security concern After minutes a line was forming so I flagged down a lovely custodian who unlocked the door and discovered thankfully no one was inside He explained It was locked in the night to prevent people from sleeping in it The fact it was not unlocked during the night in the morning means this airport was not ADA compliant and the fact that no body came after securityrelated calls were made to the operator means this airport does not have quick response to security concerns Its filthy theres food crumbs coffee dust and crud on every surface and many chairs The charging stations barely work at least in the AA terminal and nearly all of the USB direct ports are full of grey putty while the ones that arent full of putty dont charge and are loose and broken The staff here are lovely but the facilities are dismal and frankly this place is a security nightmare As a bay area resident I will never fly through here again and will never recommend this airport with a definite preference for connecting CLEAN SAFE airports like Denver IAHHobby Atlanta or Chicago

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

I had to visit Abidjan this January There is no doubt the airport is more than a pleasant surprise One would expect the worst for any West African ariport in general and even more for this one keeping in mind that the country is fairly isolated and suffering from heavy civil unrest and at the edge of civil war keeping most western travellers and business away In fact the airport corresponds totally to European counterparts of the same size fairly small thus The terminal building is very new and has been totally rebuild in a quite recent past with all confort one can expect Aircondition normal sanitary facilities and yes all is clean and in good working condition On arrival jet aircrafts just dock at a direct tunnel connection to the building distances are quite short All controls are very smooth with absolutely no bribes to give to any official While standing in line for passport control a doctor passes trough the lines and checks vaccinations Yellow fever is compulsory every where there is security passport control is smooth and efficient although every one tries to be closest to the luggage belt this also goes quite smoothly including inspection of luggage No unauthorized people in the arrival area and nowhere unpleasant people insisting on helping you carrying your luggage and then trying to run away with it apparently some people do have a sort of authorization to enter customs area for helping passengers but not insisting Departure also is quite smooth Check in is done in an enclosed area with identity check at the entrance so here also one is safe after checking in there is just a short way up the stairs passing customs and then to the departure hall Here also with all normal facilities duty free shop large restaurant area some smaller shops and sanitary facilities still clean and in good working order Altogether thus a pleasant experience

Dundee Airport provides a convenient link direct to London City Birmingham Belfast The airport is small and there are no shops There is a Costa coffee stall and the airport terminal is modern and comfortable I would recommend flying from Dundee Air France now provide the Dundee to London City route and Fly Woosh the Birmingham Belfast services My only gripe lies with the airlines themselves who do not seem to realise that if they lowered their weekend prices they could cash in on a lucrative leisure market which is put off by the high prices Dundee to London route is only worthwhile for leisure if booked way in advance and you can fly out with peak periods

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

Cleanliness of Terminal toilets and food section must be improved Toilets seems to be unattended for ages floor is full of tissues and stains Bins are full Food court tables and chairs are under the same condition which is quite surprising as per Japan standard Air Conditioning is not cool enough seats at he waiting area are also not enough However I still love to come back to visit Japan again

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

ArkhangelskARH to TromsoeTOS with a stop in MurmanskMMK Fast and easy checkin and boarding Decently comfortable and rapid security check Aircraft Antonov has seen better days but was OK for a short flight Cabin crew polite and professional Got served drinks on the first leg to Murmansk then snacks selection of meats with bread and piclkes on the way from Murmansk to Tromsoe Departure and arrival according to the timetable Luggage arrived OK Overall experience fine apart from the high price

This review is limited to Terminal This terminal is very convenient as all of Southwests gates are in one location which means connection times of minutes is more than enough to catch connecting flight As I had a very short layover I did not access WiFi The terminal was crowded midmorning but theres plenty of seating The bathrooms are very clean

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

During the checkin we paid a lot for having a few kilos over the weight limit This was dissatisfying The takeoff and landing were on time Boarding the plane was easy because it was done based on groups Extremely skilled pilot who took off and landed very safely We barely felt anything when the plane touched the ground Seats were very comfortable and the AC was strong Meals were alright given the trips short time I liked the entertainment system but was disappointed to see the WIFI was only limited to it You cant use WhatsApp for example Overrall my experience with Iberia Express was very positive and I recommend this airlineaw for a budget flight

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

Ted Stevens Anchorage Airport South domestic Terminal is a pleasure to navigate through Modern uncrowded spacious scenic with many wonderful Alaskan artifacts Seems that almost everyone photographs the giant stuffed moose upon arrival A nice variety of storeseven a McDonalds with a cent ice cream cone Comfortable and roomy observation deck Short walk to be connected to People Mover city bus Alaska Railroad and rental cars no need to ride shuttle bus The most complete and careful security check I have experienced

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame

You know its a shame that this beautiful airport cannot supply enough helpful staff to assist with directing you to the right place in order to make your connecting flight If only there were those who could advise you what you need to do when you DO have a boarding pass in your possession and that you must take a bus to another part of the terminal to board your connecting flight The whole experience almost tainted the start and end to a brilliant holiday

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Syrian Arab Airlines LHRDamascusLHR Flights departed ontime aircraft an A The crew were helpful and efficient and we were supplied with one main meal which was fine We were also given a drink during the flight Havent used them for an internal flight but would be happy to use them again on an international flight

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports

Went through KLIA terminal one domestic section for morning departure and afternoon arrival Despite the age the airport maintains its cleanliness The toilets were kept clean and spotless by the cleaner all the times The custom check for domestic flight a bit crowded due to higher number of flights However the whole process at the custom check was very efficient Lots of cafes and shops available to fill up the time while waiting for flights The wifi works very well for me The baggage claim section still under maintenance I think Its been awhile and the airport management need to check on this Overall very satisfied with the airport facilities and management for domestic section airside I think this airport need a bigger new terminal soon as the present terminal already seems and feels crowded
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

Nice airport but needs modification I have been travelling through this Airport for some time and it is not the best but it is being upgraded and work is going on right now so hopefully it will be a very nice and beautiful Air port with a lot of new facilities Airport need better management in dealing with multiple flights and improving the cleanliness

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Domestic terminal is easy to use not much going on and no crowds or wait times It has sufficient seating capabilities but restaurant and shopping options are fairly limited But it serves its purpose is reasonably clean and convenient

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options
